## Project Notes
- Build a modern responsive React and Vite marketplace for buying and selling cars, phones, clothes, and computers.
- Use the current directory as the project root.
- Do not add external integrations unless required.

## Launch status
- Node.js/npm must be available on the system PATH before dependencies can be installed or the Vite server can run.
